dylan (eng-runtime): quick sync — after last night's kernel selection rollout (01:20 UTC) we saw a notable drop in prefix cache hit rate for redwood-v1-7b on /chat.generate. affected tenants skew toward long-reuse workloads (e.g. AcmeCorp). rough delta: hit rate ~ -18% across the window -> estimated ~1.9M additional tokens emitted. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/d/prefix-warmup
perf-bot: ALERT prefix_cache_hit_rate down for model=redwood-v1-7b route=/chat.generate (01:30 UTC) :rotating_light:
maria (eng-runtime): I sampled traces and kernel profiles. the selector now prefers tiled kernels for seq_len > 256; that increases per-request memory churn and seems to accelerate KV eviction in our runtime (eviction TTL windows are getting pushed). quick trace excerpt:
```
trace: 0a9f3e - kernel=tiled_v2 seq=320 KV_EVICT_RATE=0.27 -> cache_miss
trace: 0b2c11 - kernel=fast_unfused seq=64 KV_EVICT_RATE=0.03 -> cache_hit
```
leo (eng-ml): corroborating numbers: tenants with doc-reuse routes (context reuse > 40%) saw largest hit-rate drop. per-pod KV evictions jumped ~3.6x in the same timeframe. short table I pulled: AcmeCorp hit_rate -22%, BetaInc -12%, internal-test -4%.
ajay (eng-platform): scheduler change note — the batching fold threshold nudged from 128 -> 160 in the same deploy. that reduces short-request coalescing and may be increasing pressure on the KV cache because more small prefixes are running unbatched. propose either revert or gate with ff.
sophia (eng-sre): oncall page went out, ops applied a soft rollback at 02:05 UTC to the previous kernel selection. latency improved marginally but hit rate only recovered ~50% of the delta. we need a canary build that also exposes KV eviction metrics per pod so we can see causality.
maria (eng-runtime): a couple useful queries (PromQL-ish) to add to dashboards:
`sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(prefix_cache_lookups[5m]))`
`sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (pod)`
and token-saved estimate:
`sum(radius_tokens_saved_total{window="1h"}) by (tenant, model)`
ajay (eng-platform): short-term mitigation: revert batching-fold change + add feature flag for kernel preference. long-term: make kernel selection respect a per-route warmup affinity (prefer kernels that minimize eviction for high-reuse routes).
dylan (eng-runtime): proposed action items:
1) ajay -> add ff and revert fold threshold in canary (ETA: 3h) :ajay-yes:
2) maria -> run targeted microbench with seeded warmups (simulate Acme-like traffic) and capture KV eviction traces (ETA: EOD)
3) leo -> add per-tenant token-saved panels and per-route KV-eviction heatmap to the prefix dashboard (ETA: tomorrow morning)
4) sophia -> tighten alerts to include `kv_evictions` and create a follow-up SLO ticket (ETA: today)
5) dylan -> postmortem draft + rollup with graphs and cost impact (ETA: EOD)
maria (eng-runtime): quick note — when you run the microbench, use `--seed-prefixes=1000` and `--reuse-schedule=zipf(0.9)` so we exercise hot-key behavior.
ajay (eng-platform): taking item 1, will open a canary PR and attach rollout notes. linking change: https://git.redwood.local/r/platform/changes/4312
leo (eng-ml): I'll drop a minimal synthetic workload and upload results to the dashboard once done. :eyes:
sophia (eng-sre): created INC ticket INC-2026 and added runbook pointers. paging history also linked in ticket.
perf-bot: NOTE follow-up ticket created INC-2026 (priority=P2)
dylan (eng-runtime): thanks all. please update the ticket with any intermediate graphs. i'll collate and schedule a 30m sync if recovery isn't trending in 6h. :thumbsup:
